exact_statement: For n>=2, the unit vector v=(1,-1,0,...,0)/sqrt(2) and an iid Rademacher row R satisfy P(<R,v>=0)=1/2. Consequently an all-unit-vectors bound P(|<R,v>|<=t)<=K*t fails at t=0 for every finite K.
